name: Cushing Plaza
summary: Cushing Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center located on Chief Justice Cushing Highway in Cohasset, Massachusetts, serving the affluent South Shore community with convenient retail and services. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, this well-positioned center provides essential shopping options for local residents in one of Massachusetts' most desirable coastal towns.
demographics: Cushing Plaza serves the affluent coastal community of Cohasset and surrounding South Shore Massachusetts towns, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes significantly above the state median. The trade area draws residents from nearby Scituate, Hingham, and Norwell, with shoppers typically aged 35-65 who value convenience and quality over discount pricing. The center caters to established homeowners and families seeking everyday necessities and services in a convenient neighborhood setting, with shopping patterns focused on regular grocery runs, pharmacy visits, and quick-service dining.
description: Cushing Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center strategically located at 739 Chief Justice Cushing Highway in the heart of Cohasset, Massachusetts, serving the affluent South Shore community. This convenient retail destination provides essential services and shopping options for local residents along one of the area's main commercial corridors. The center operates daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, offering accessible shopping hours for busy families and professionals in this coastal New England town. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a nationally recognized shopping center REIT specializing in grocery-anchored properties, Cushing Plaza benefits from professional management and strategic tenant curation. The center's location in Cohasset, known for its scenic harbor, historic charm, and high quality of life, positions it as a valued community gathering place for daily shopping needs and services.
